mapper.select: select token_hash, family_id, expires_at, used_at, revoked_at from refresh_session where token_hash = #{tokenHash}
select family_id, user_id, expires_at, revoked_at from refresh_family where family_id = #{familyId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into refresh_family(family_id, user_id, expires_at) values (#{familyId}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt})
insert into refresh_session(token_hash, family_id, expires_at) values (#{tokenHash}, #{familyId}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: update refresh_session set used_at = #{now} where token_hash = #{tokenHash} and used_at is null and revoked_at is null
update refresh_family set revoked_at = coalesce(revoked_at, #{now}) where family_id = #{familyId}
update refresh_session set revoked_at = coalesce(revoked_at, #{now}) where family_id = #{familyId}
mapper.insert: insert into auth_security_event(event_id, user_id, family_id, event_type, created_at) values (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{familyId}, #{eventType}, #{now})
